comparison.objective: Adjust robot-axis damping versus safely dismantle battery busbars after service isolation.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool use and iterative impact testing versus plug removal, busbar lifting, clearance management, and possibly nut handling.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe stop cycles and retained adjustment versus correct isolation order, cleared conductors, tray placement, and avoidance of terminal contact.
comparison.reason: Different mechanisms, hazards, and verified end states. Candidate rebound/overload/drift limits are not numeric.
